origin.label: Name & Meaning
origin.title: O means Ocean, and also a journey from zero
origin.desc: OTools blends the ocean with tools, conveying ecosystem, scale, and the spirit of going from 0 to 1.
points: O comes from Ocean, symbolizing inclusiveness and abundant plugins; official plugins follow oceanic names to extend the system.
O looks like 0, implying a fresh start and a new platform for the AI era.
Ocean + Tools sounds like OTools; the Chinese name “Sea Rabbit” represents a light, agile tool companion.
origin.cardDesc: Lightweight, agile, inspiration-driven AI workflow platform
origin.quote: From the ocean, gather tools; become the foundation for real AI workflows.
